reason: I have run my two-person practice on Excel spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years without paying a rupee, and I am skeptical that introducing software will do anything except add an extra forwarding step to my week. I will not spend ₹12,990 upfront when my existing spreadsheets get the job done for free.
objection: Clients will always just dump bills on WhatsApp, so having my assistant or me manually forward every document into Docketra sounds like extra work rather than a time-saver.
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot and seeing it genuinely eliminate my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation without creating manual forwarding overhead.
